description: A team lead must redesign a weekly cross-functional retrospective after participants report that its discussion format is discouraging candid participation. The lead must set the participation format, notice period, facilitation arrangement, incident record, and initial support commitments.

shared_context.S1: The cross-functional retrospective currently meets for 60 minutes every Thursday afternoon.
shared_context.S2: Several participants have said that interruptions and improvised exercises make it harder to discuss problems candidly.
shared_context.S3: The current retrospective facilitator is leaving the team at the end of the month.
shared_context.S4: Maya's routine for changing team processes is to take a round-robin of concrete constraints, specific observations, and proposed commitments from each participant, record each person's exact input, read the record back to the group, and review the complete record before finalizing the new process.

PF1.text: Renee needs questions and discussion prompts in writing at least 48 hours before the retrospective and cannot take part in unmoderated live role-play; she has not raised this in the group because prior prompts have usually arrived informally on the day of the meeting.

PF2.text: Jon personally observed exactly four occasions this quarter when one participant interrupted another during the retrospective, and he previously agreed to serve as the neutral timekeeper for the first six revised sessions; he has not put either point into the team's process notes.

acceptance_conditions: The revised retrospective must require written questions and discussion prompts, prohibit unmoderated live role-play, and provide the prompts exactly 48 hours in advance.
The process must document exactly four interruption incidents.
The first six revised sessions must use a neutral-timekeeper facilitation arrangement.
A commitment must assign Jon as neutral timekeeper for the first six revised sessions.

content_checks.C4: decisions['timekeeper_sessions'] == 6 and decisions['facilitation_model'] in ['neutral timekeeper', 'new facilitator with neutral timekeeper support for first six revised sessions', 'new facilitator with neutral timekeeper support for first six revised sessions', 'neutral timekeeper with rotating facilitation', 'neutral timekeeper with rotating facilitation; new facilitator to be assigned after current facilitator departs at end of month']
content_checks.C5: any(c['target'] == 'Jon' and c['type'] in ['timekeeping', 'role_commitment', 'commitment'] and c['detail'] in ['Jon to serve as neutral timekeeper for the first six revised sessions', 'Jon to serve as neutral timekeeper for the first six revised retrospective sessions.', 'Jon will serve as neutral timekeeper for the first six revised retrospective sessions.', 'Will serve as neutral timekeeper for the first six revised retrospective sessions.'] for c in commitments)

provenance_checks.P1: 'PF1' in credited_facts and 'PF1' in justification_fact_ids and 'PF1' in revealed
provenance_checks.P2: 'PF2' in credited_facts and 'PF2' in justification_fact_ids and 'PF2' in revealed

decisive_facts.why: Renee's specific participation boundary changes written_prompts_required to True, unmoderated_role_play_allowed to False, and agenda_notice_hours to exactly 48.

Jon's firsthand record changes documented_interruption_count to exactly 4, while his prior agreement changes facilitation_model to a neutral-timekeeper arrangement, timekeeper_sessions to exactly 6, and the commitment to assign Jon for those six sessions.
